system.name: Identity Secure Gate
system.description: Complete IAM platform for hybrid and multi-cloud environments, supporting OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML 2.0, and SCIM. It centralizes identity lifecycle management with RBAC/ABAC, SSO, Adaptive MFA, PAM, and real-time audit logs for GDPR, LGPD, and ISO 27001 compliance.
